intent.description: What the sender wants. 'support' is an existing customer with a problem.

budget_amount.description: Budget as a number, only if the customer stated one. null if not stated. Never guess.

budget_currency.description: Currency code or symbol for the stated budget (for example MYR for RM). null if no budget.

decision_maker.description: Can the sender decide? 'no' if gathering quotes for someone else. 'unknown' if unclear.

urgency_score.description: 1 no timeline, 2 vague or someday, 3 within a few months, 4 a stated date or within weeks, 5 wants contact now.

objection.description: Why they hesitated, in a few words (for example 'budget too low'). null if none.

summary.description: One sentence in English a salesperson can read before replying.

evidence.description: Up to 3 short quotes copied from the conversation that justify the scores.

confidence.description: How sure you are, from 0 to 1.
